subject: Money
title: Mining and Proof of Work
description: A tiny lesson with a big payoff: Mining and Proof of Work.

hook.text: Bitcoin mining consumes as much electricity as Argentina—a country of 46 million people. All to verify transactions.

buildup.text: Miners compete to solve complex math puzzles. The winner gets to add the next block and earns fresh Bitcoin.

discovery.text: This is Proof of Work: you prove you spent computational energy. It makes cheating incredibly expensive.

twist.text: Most mining now happens in industrial-scale facilities. Home mining is unprofitable. It's a corporate arms race.

climax.text: Proof of Work is secure but wasteful. It's the original consensus model that proved decentralization could work.

quiz.question: What must miners do to add a new block?
